comparison_targets: H-012 / REP-0032 15m Donchian breakout with funding filter

proposed_mechanics.anchor: Previous-bar high/low only, with no rolling highest-high/lowest-low channel and no Donchian channel width/midline anchor.
proposed_mechanics.trigger: Range-expansion breakout through the immediately previous bar high/low, conditioned on ATR-normalized candle range and participation.
proposed_mechanics.gate: Relative volume threshold is required and parameterized by rvol_lookback_bars and rvol_min; min_bars_between_entries is fixed at 8.
proposed_mechanics.normalization: ATR-normalized range threshold through range_atr_min; RVOL measures current volume versus rolling volume baseline.
proposed_mechanics.entry_logic: Both-direction breakout entries require previous-bar high/low break plus RVOL and range-expansion confirmation.
proposed_mechanics.exit_or_risk_logic: ATR stop multiple 2.0 is proposed; no Donchian midline/channel exit is proposed.

concluded_family_mechanics.gate: No RVOL participation gate recorded in REP-0003; simple Donchian trend context.
concluded_family_mechanics.normalization: No ATR-normalized range-expansion gate recorded in REP-0003.
concluded_family_mechanics.exit_or_risk_logic: Baseline symmetric trend-following exits under the research workbench.

concluded_family_mechanics.anchor: Prior-bar rolling high/low Donchian breakout channel on 15m.
concluded_family_mechanics.trigger: Donchian breakout using prior-bar rolling high/low.
concluded_family_mechanics.gate: Funding context filter blocks or flattens long when funding exceeds a positive threshold and short when funding is below a negative threshold; min_hold before state changes.
concluded_family_mechanics.normalization: No RVOL participation gate and no ATR-normalized range-expansion trigger recorded as the defining signal.
concluded_family_mechanics.entry_logic: Donchian breakout with funding filter; pure Donchian comparator also recorded.
concluded_family_mechanics.exit_or_risk_logic: Baseline trend exits; funding-filtered and pure comparator both liquidated.

mechanical_differences: The proposed breakout level is the immediately previous bar high/low, not a Donchian rolling channel upper/lower level over a multi-bar lookback.
RVOL is load-bearing because entries require abnormal participation; removing RVOL would change the declared denominator axes and the economic thesis.
ATR-normalized range expansion is part of the trigger, while the Donchian targets are channel-breakout mechanics.
H-012 uses funding as the context filter; HYP-002R is OHLCV-only and uses volume participation instead.
H-002 is 4h and HYP-002R is 15m; timeframe alone is not counted as sufficient, but it supports the different event definition.
mechanical_overlaps: Both HYP-002R and the Donchian targets are breakout or continuation family ideas.
Both HYP-002R and H-012 can reference previous information before the current trigger bar.
All compared surfaces are BTCUSDT perpetual research hypotheses and not execution authority.
load_bearing_fresh_elements: rvol_min and rvol_lookback_bars are explicit denominator axes.
range_atr_min is an explicit denominator axis.
breakout_reference is fixed to previous_bar_high_low rather than a Donchian channel.
The economic rationale depends on participation-confirmed range expansion rather than channel trend following.
cosmetic_elements: Shared breakout/continuation vocabulary is cosmetic unless formalization switches to rolling-channel mechanics.
The 15m timeframe by itself is not sufficient distinctness.
reason: Repo-truth proposal mechanics define a previous-bar/range-expansion/RVOL participation breakout, while the concluded targets are Donchian channel breakout families. A future formalized artifact must preserve the previous-bar and RVOL/range-expansion requirements; if it substitutes rolling Donchian channel levels, this pass no longer holds.
